data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 refuses to answer which of the two properties the log must require, instead proposing 'replay-determinism' as a third, distinct property. But its own definition—'the operation's effect on the log is determined solely by its logical content, not by its invocation count or timing'—is precisely idempotency where the relevant state space is log content. General idempotency is always defined relative to a state domain; restricting that domain to log content does not create a new property. SRC_001 itself concedes this in a countercondition: 'If replay-determinism is shown to be equivalent to idempotency restricted to log-content as the relevant state, this collapses into Candidate 1.' A property that the target admits may be identical to one of the two it claims to supersede is not a genuine third property. SRC_001 thus fails to answer the question as posed (which of the two) and its proposed alternative reduces to idempotency, offering no real distinction.
